description: Take advantage of the nice weather and eat your meals on the patio on this stylish 6 piece patio garden table set with umbrella. If you want to relocate your seating to another location on the deck, sit poolside or take it with you while camping or to an outdoor sporting event, the lightweight and compact design offer an easy to transport option. The folding chairs are upholstered in a durable, breathable textilene material, designed for all-weather use. The attractive rippled tempered glass sits atop a 4-legged metal framed base. The included umbrella will shade you on those sunny days and has a tilt function that is activated by pushing the plastic ring on the pole. Take the stresses of the day away with this all-in-one patio table set for dining, entertaining, and relaxing.
